summary: The victim received a phone call from an individual impersonating a Belgian police officer who claimed that Ledger and Coincover related identity fraud had exposed the victim's assets. The caller used personal information and fabricated technical explanations to build credibility and solicit sensitive confirmations regarding the victim's cryptocurrency setup.
user_mistake: Verified personal details and engaged with an unsolicited caller claiming authority over a crypto security incident
prevention: Terminate unsolicited calls claiming urgent crypto security issues/Contact organizations directly using official channels to confirm claims
